Catalogue lacks stud ports for the wedge, so most joins to b1/b7 use null ports.
Placement of the tower (b12) on b3 and b11 and of the clip equipment (b22, b24) on the skids is inferred from small pictures.
The part ids for step 5 and 6 numbering follow the parts list: windscreen b17, tile b18, axle b19, connector b20, pin b21.
Hinge top b14 is assumed to be mounted on the hinge base b13, and tile b18 sits on b14.
The minifigure (hard hat, torso, legs) is not in the parts list, so it is not modelled.
The pages are pictures only. The exact stud positions, the build order and some piece placements are my best reading, so many stud port names are approximate.
I assumed the 2x2 bricks go under the base and carry the wheel holders. I assumed the 2x6 plate and wedge sit under the base.
I assumed the hinge plate (44567a) mounts on the front of the base. The hinge brick connects to it, and the bucket hinges to the hinge brick.
I assumed the two clip plates are at the rear and hold the shovel and the jackhammer.
I assumed the cone sits on the roll bar (4083), and the seat sits on the 2x2 plate.
I used wheel holder b17 for wheels 1 and 2 and b18 for wheels 3 and 4.

notes: Many parts boxes were missing from the extracted pages (steps 6-16, 19), so some attachment points are inferred from the final model photos and the parts list.
Part ids b1-b25 cover the non-repeated body and head pieces in build order. Arms (4 parts x2) and legs (6 parts x2) are repeats, which makes 45 pieces in total.

Arm hinge halves are modelled with one hinge anti-stud on a body stud (b2 or b3 stud.1.2), the clip plate on hinge stud.1.1 and the curved brick on hinge stud.1.2. The arms are mirror images, but the hinge has no mirror twin, so no mirror override is used.
Where the flames attach in step 19 is not clear. They are modelled as bar-in-clip on each arm hinge's clip.1.
Eyes (ball joints) are assumed to sit by their axle-hole on the two outer jumper-plate studs on the head. The tile with clip sits on the centre jumper and holds the handlebars eyebrow.
The head stack (wedge, 1x4 plate, 1x2 plates, cheese slopes, 2x4 plate) and the teeth, slope and jaw positions are best-guess from the step pictures.
The 3665 inverted slope has no stud port in the catalogue, so its port is left null on the join to the knee plate's anti-studs.
Leg: 14417 ball goes into the 14419 socket, and the 14419 ball goes into the body's 14704 socket. All other joins are stud/anti-stud push-on.
